enchantments.tooltip: Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +59 (Competence bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Natural Armor +14: Passive: +14 Natural Armor Bonus to Armor Class.

Proof Against Disease +12: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural diseases. This item also grants a +12 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical diseases, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical diseases with a DC of less than 13 + their Fortitude save).
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
